## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — news3400/iop.

`config.mk` records 5 source file(s) here: `fb.c`, `fb_sub.c`, `iop.c`, `kb.c`, `rs.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
